description: cmix v21 forced text-mode wrapper using the mmap allocator plus PAQ8 level 4 instead of level 11. The binary and english.dic are gzip-compressed and counted toward program_size.
hypothesis: PAQ8 level 5 produced a strong 250K archive but crossed the 10 GiB ceiling during decode. PAQ8 level 4 should reduce memory pressure enough to complete the same gate while preserving enough of cmix21 text-mode density to remain a frontier candidate.
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
POSIX mmap and temporary filesystem space
verdict: Rejected for archive quality. PAQ4 fixed memory pressure but destroyed the 250K archive slope before completion, so it is not a credible path to 10.95%.
